hierarchy.mainline: PRODUCT_MAINLINE AMD_CUSTOM_X86 (Platform Core v1) — qualifier required
hierarchy.guiding_question: Does the simpler or specialized variant outperform the relevant track baseline enough to justify promotion with measured evidence?

experiments.title: ARM IQX-class SoM vs custom AMD Platform Core v1
experiments.hypothesis: ARM SoM reduces idle power and BOM cost at equal desk productivity vs owned custom AMD motherboard
experiments.promotion_gate: All metrics meet or beat baseline on EVT sample n>=3 AND Device OS RC1 interface register shows zero P0 breaks; owner accepts reduced x86 ownership

experiments.title: Student OLED panel vs IPS
experiments.hypothesis: OLED improves contrast/weight without exceeding power/thermal budget
experiments.baseline: IPS eDP panel on custom Student-MB-v1
experiments.promotion_gate: Power <= IPS+10% at 200 nits office; burn-in mitigation plan owner-approved

experiments.title: DS-XL OLED+IPS hybrid vs dual IPS
experiments.hypothesis: Primary OLED + secondary IPS improves creator UX without dual-OLED cost/thermal
experiments.baseline: IPS eDP + DDI/DP on custom DSXL-MB-v1
experiments.promotion_gate: SI margin maintained on eDP+DDI/DP; do not mislabel as dual native eDP

experiments.title: Dock USB4 80 vs USB4 40
experiments.hypothesis: USB4 80 improves external display/storage UX enough to justify controller cost/SI risk
experiments.promotion_gate: Measured eye margin; no mainline mix until DVT

experiments.title: Inductive ring charge vs magnetic cradle contacts
experiments.hypothesis: Inductive charge improves durability/UX with acceptable efficiency and EMI
experiments.promotion_gate: Efficiency >=70% at EVT coil; EMI does not fail pre-scan relative to baseline

experiments.title: sEMG wrist band vs IMU/cap ring input
experiments.hypothesis: sEMG adds gesture bandwidth without unsafe skin current / privacy regression
experiments.promotion_gate: Safety current limits met; youth privacy review pass; not medical claim

experiments.title: coreboot/openSIL vs vendor UEFI on custom Platform Core
experiments.hypothesis: Reproducible host firmware is achievable without blocking production on vendor UEFI/AGESA path
experiments.baseline: Vendor-supported UEFI + AGESA on custom AMD motherboard
experiments.variant: coreboot and/or AMD openSIL when production-capable for selected platform
experiments.promotion_gate: Must not block mainline; only promote after production-capable platform support

experiments.title: RAUC A/B vs vendor capsule/EC update
experiments.hypothesis: RAUC improves update safety/ops for custom platforms vs vendor capsule-only flows
experiments.baseline: Vendor capsule + custom EC update orchestration
experiments.promotion_gate: No P0 Device OS RC1 breaks; measured field-ops improvement

experiments.title: COM-HPC modular product architecture vs custom motherboard mainline
experiments.hypothesis: COM-HPC modular path matches product goals with lower board complexity; measure whether giving up motherboard ownership is justified
experiments.variant: ADLINK COM-HPC Mini mMTL + Mini Base REFERENCE_CONTROL_MODULAR_X86
experiments.promotion_gate: Measured evidence that modular path meets product goals AND owner explicitly accepts reduced motherboard ownership; cannot silently become mainline

experiments.title: DS-XL Ryzen AI Embedded X100-class vs 8845HS mainline
experiments.hypothesis: X100/X168i-class improves local AI/create workloads enough to justify LPDDR5X/PCB complexity and power
experiments.promotion_gate: Physical comparison n>=3; do not promote without measured data

experiments.title: Student P132/P132i AI-first vs 8840U mainline
experiments.hypothesis: Higher NPU prioritization beats 8840U for gunnchAI local workloads without unacceptable GPU/game/battery regression
experiments.promotion_gate: Physical comparison; AI-first SKU only after evidence; does not replace mainline now
